new_claim.statement: For independent real coordinate densities <=K and symmetric A with s_8(A)>=s>0, arbitrary affine b,c, the quadratic polynomial has an essentially bounded density with norm <2400 K^2/s.
new_claim.new_essential_step: The robust-pair two-high leverage branch is impossible: two q_i>2/3 force one 2x2 cross minor square >g/3, while the no-pivot entry cap makes every such minor square <10201/25000000 and robust extraction gives g/3>8/75.

partner_application.result: On seven large residual coordinates in the terminal collar, symmetrization gives rank<=4 plus entrywise epsilon_*=3sqrt(2)/80, hence s_3>=1-3sqrt(2)/10 and density <40.
